# NTC pipeline ecosystem catalog

The Nascent Transcription Core (NTC / Adelman lab, HMS) toolset for **PRO-seq,
TT-seq, RNA-seq, Start-seq and ChIP-seq**: read mapping, TSS/gene annotation, browser tracks,
and nascent-transcription analyses (pausing, enhancer RNAs, metagenes, expression
matching). Most tools are **HMS-O2-specific**: hardcoded `/n/data1/...` paths and
**group-based selection** (`id -Gn` → `hpc_ntc` under `/n/data1/cores/ntc`, else
`hpc_adelman` under `/n/data1/hms/bcmp/adelman`). Load a tool's skill for detail.

**Two execution styles — don't assume.** A *smartSlurm pipeline* is an annotated bash
driver with `#@` step markers that `runAsPipeline` turns into a Slurm DAG (`ssbatch`
sizing, flag-folder rerun). Only **RNAseqMapping, pipeline2, DOBBE_F, and now ChIPseq**
are these (ChIPseq gained an rAP driver in its 2026 cleanup, alongside a still-present
legacy fan-out). Everything else is standalone scripts — several (GGA, MHT, peakMorph)
build their own `sbatch --dependency` DAGs by hand, which is **not** smartSlurm.
`make_heatmap` (from NIH_scripts) is the shared matrix engine behind most analysis tools.

## Foundation
- **smartSlurm** (`runAsPipeline`, `ssbatch`, rAP) — the pipeline engine. Parses `#@`
  bash annotations into a Slurm job DAG with resource estimation and rerun/resume.
  *Substrate under RNAseqMapping / pipeline2 / DOBBE_F / ChIPseq.* Authoritative branch is
  now **`master`** (the `ux-update` work merged in 2026-10 and that branch was deleted);
  named-flag CLI, `#@end` explicit block closure, **jobRecords v2** history, and
  `checkRun`/`checkRunGrid`/`diagnose.sh`. The slurmless Slurm-free test harness now lives
  **in-tree at `smartSlurm/slurmless/`** (merged 2026-11-11, PR #144; the standalone
  `slurmless_smartSlurm_testing` is **deprecated** — direct all slurmless work at the in-tree copy)
  and ships three skills: `slurmless-harness` (the harness), `smartslurm-adversary` (pre-push
  adversarial review), and `migration-assistant` (hand-rolled-SLURM→rAP). **Any smartSlurm change
  must be paired with a slurmless harness update** (a block that fails without it) and passed through
  `smartslurm-adversary` before on-cluster testing or an upstream push.
  Use when: writing/modifying any rAP driver.
  → skills `smartslurm-pipelines`, `slurmless-harness`, `smartslurm-adversary`; `reference/runAsPipeline-grammar.md`.
- **Genome_Onboarding** (`genome_setup`) — onboard a reference genome. In: GTF+FASTA
  URLs, spike FASTA, config. Out: UCSC-named `basic.gtf`, bowtie2/STAR/kallisto indexes,
  chrom.sizes, TSS `formakeheatmap` lists → NTC shared storage. Downstream: ~everything.
  Use when: adding a genome / building indexes or annotations.
- **ntc_env** — conda/mamba env YAMLs (one per tool) + dREG install recipe. Provides
  `ntc`/`ntc_basic`, `proseq_env`, `gga`, `rnaseq_env`, `genome_setup_env`,
  `ntc-extra` (`how_are_we_stranded_here` etc.), `dreg`.
  Use when: choosing/building an env or debugging version pins (esp. dREG CUDA/R).
- **NIH_scripts** (`make_heatmap`, `bowtie2stdBedGraph`, `bedgraphs2stdBedGraph`,
  `normalize_bedGraph`, trim_and_filter) — low-level NGS utilities (Perl/C++). The
  shared toolbox: bedGraph build/merge/normalize + metagene matrices. Consumed by GGA,
  pipeline2, DOBBE_F, MHT, pauseIndex, proTSScall, prepareBrowser, peakMorph.

## Mapping (reads → alignments, coverage, DE)
- **RNAseqMapping** — RNA-seq / TT-seq mapping w/ spike-in (**rAP**). In: PE FASTQ +
  manifest (`read1 read2 sample condition`), ref/spike genomes. Out: dedup BAMs,
  raw strand-split bedGraph/bigWig, DESeq2. Downstream: prepareBrowser, Expression-
  Matching, (TT-seq) TSS/metagene tools. Use when: mapping RNA-seq/TT-seq.
- **pipeline2** (`proseq`, MainPipeline) — PRO-seq / Start-seq mapping + QC (**rAP**).
  In: PE FASTQ + PRO-seq metadata CSV, ref+spike combined index. Out: ref+spike BAMs,
  1-nt & bin10 **3'/5' stranded bedGraphs**, make_heatmap matrices, DESeq2, QC. The
  PRO-seq hub feeding proTSScall, DOBBE_F, prepareBrowser, pauseIndex, MHT, peakMorph.
  Emits **bedGraphs, not bigWigs**. Use when: mapping PRO-seq/Start-seq.
- **ChIPseq** (`ChIP-seq mapping`, `ChIPseq_rAP_pipeline_submission`) — ChIP-seq / CUT&RUN
  mapping + peaks + QC. **Now a smartSlurm/rAP pipeline** (19-step `#@…#@end` driver), with
  the **legacy plain-`sbatch` fan-out still present**. In: **header-driven TSV manifest**
  (per-library; antibody/input-control auto-resolution; PE or SE), bowtie1 indexes. Out:
  per-antibody output tree — BAMs, unstranded bedGraph/bigWig tracks, HOMER peaks, TSS/TES +
  whole-transcript metaplots (make_heatmap), ChIPQC/MultiQC/peak-corr, mapping-stats. Single
  in-repo conda env `chipseq` (**not yet in ntc_env** — gap NTC-013a). Uses GGA/proTSScall
  `formakeheatmap` anchors; overlaps MHT. **"Under development"; rAP path not yet validated on
  real O2 Slurm.** Use when: mapping/QC-ing ChIP-seq. → skill `chipseq`.

## Annotation (define TSS/TES/dominant transcripts)
- **TSScall** (`obsTSS`, `uTSS`) — call annotated + novel TSSs from 1-nt 5' bedGraphs.
  In: fwd/rev 5' bedGraphs, chrom.sizes, optional GTF. Out: TSS BED + detail TSV.
  Upstream: 5' bedGraphs (pipeline2). Downstream: GGA (vendors it), DOBBE_F (detail file).
- **GeneAnnotationScripts** (**GGA**, GetGeneAnnotations) — **central annotation hub**.
  In: RNA-seq manifest (kallisto TPMs) + optional PRO-seq 5' bedGraphs (→ TSScall). Out:
  one dominant TSS/TES per gene: `*_WORKING_FILE.txt`, `*_for_dREG.txt`,
  `*_formakeheatmap.txt`, `*_Affiliated.ActiveTranscripts_forfeaturecounts.gtf`.
  Downstream: DOBBE_F, MHT, Expression-Matching, pauseIndex, peakMorph. Hand-rolled
  sbatch DAG (not rAP). Use when: generating/using GGA dominant TSS/TES annotations.
- **proTSScall** — pick one dominant active TSS per gene from PRO-seq 3' bedGraphs + a
  TSS/TES list (**not** a TSScall fork). Out: `*_dominant_formakeheatmap.txt`.
  Upstream: pipeline2 3' bedGraphs + a TSS list. Downstream: MHT, pauseIndex.

## Browser tracks
- **prepareBrowser** — depth-normalize + condition-merge strand bedGraphs → browser
  bigWigs (`genomebrowser-uploads/`) and `browser_{forward,reverse}*/<cond>/` tracks.
  Upstream: pipeline2 (PRO) / RNAseqMapping (RNA). Downstream: pauseIndex; UCSC/IGV.

## Downstream analysis
- **pauseIndex** (`calc-pi`) — RNA Pol II pausing index (promoter/body density ratio)
  per TSS per condition + plots. In: PRO-seq browser bedGraphs + TSS/TES `formakeheatmap`
  (GGA/proTSScall) + genemap. Upstream: prepareBrowser, GGA/proTSScall. Terminal.
- **DOBBE_F** (DOBBE, dREG eRNA) — enhancer-RNA calling (**rAP**). In: PRO-seq 3'
  bedGraphs (→ bigWig → dREG, GPU) + GGA dir. Out: filtered/annotated eRNA peaks +
  a make_heatmap v3 anchor file. Upstream: pipeline2 + GGA. Downstream: MHT.
- **Expression-Matching** (`expressionMatched`, `matchit_match`) — matched unchanged-gene
  control lists for PRO-seq DE. **Restructured 2026-11:** primary entry `matchit_match.R` (flag
  CLI; default **MatchIt** covariate matcher — expression + optional length/GC/…; legacy decile
  via `--method expression`, or frozen `archive/main.R`). In: DESeq2 output (`results_table`,
  `makeHeatmap.rds`) + GGA `WORKING_FILE`. Out: `matched_controls.<method>.txt` (+ SMD-balance/QC
  plots); legacy path still emits `expression_matched-<baseline>_{1,2,3}.txt`. New dep **MatchIt**
  (**confirmed ntc_env gap** — in no env YAML; NTC-027a). Upstream: DESeq2 + GGA. Downstream: MHT (controls).
- **metagene_heatmap_tool** (**MHT**) — metagene + heatmap figures/matrices (Prism-ready).
  In: PRO/TT/ChIP stranded bedGraphs + GGA **or** proTSScall annotation. Hand-rolled
  sbatch DAG. Upstream: mapping bedGraphs + GGA/proTSScall/DOBBE_F anchor. Terminal.
- **peakMorph_toolkit** (`peakMorph`) — PRO-seq peak-morphology QC: TapeStation shape
  features + remap-postprocess region/insert metrics (`sbatch --array`, not rAP). In:
  pipeline2 bedGraphs/BAMs + GGA `formakeheatmap` annotation. Terminal review artifacts.
  *In flux (2026, pilot-stage) — catalog entry only, no skill yet.*

## Dev / test
- **slurmless** (`smartSlurm/slurmless/`) — Slurm-free regression harness for **smartSlurm itself**
  (mock sbatch/sacct + fixtures; **~64 test blocks**, incl. a Migration-Assistant hand-rolled-SLURM→rAP
  suite). **Merged into smartSlurm 2026-11-11** (PR #144) — it now lives in-tree at `smartSlurm/slurmless/`,
  versioned with the engine; the standalone repo `slurmless_smartSlurm_testing` is **deprecated** (direct
  all future slurmless work at the in-tree copy). Carries three skills — `slurmless-harness`,
  `smartslurm-adversary` (pre-push adversarial review), `migration-assistant` (hand-rolled-SLURM→rAP).
  Not wired to NTC pipelines; useful to prototype rAP conversion / estimator changes without a cluster.
  Load it to test an rAP driver (incl. ChIPseq) off-cluster before O2. **Co-versioning rule:** any
  smartSlurm change ships with a paired slurmless update + an `smartslurm-adversary` review pass.
  → skills `slurmless-harness`, `smartslurm-adversary`.

## Ops / QC utilities
- **utilities** (`ntc-agnt/utilities`) — grab-bag of standalone helper scripts (not smartSlurm). Each has its
  own README. (1) `distribute.sh` — PRO-seq data **distribution** helper: archive a
  pipeline2 outdir to `userData`, stage large files to scratch, and curate + `rclone`
  to Dropbox, driven by the PRO-seq metadata CSV; additive-only, dry-run-first, runs on
  an HMS transfer node. Consumes pipeline2 outputs (bedGraphs, GGA/proTSScall calls,
  DESeq2, pause_index, browser bigWigs). (2) `hawsh.sh` — RNA-seq/TT-seq **strandedness
  QC** wrapper around `check_strandedness` (`how_are_we_stranded_here`, from `ntc_env`'s
  `ntc-extra` env); complements RNAseqMapping, uses the same NTC-hosted references.
  *Catalog entry only, no skill yet.*

## Relationships (data-flow DAG)

```
 ntc_env (conda envs) ─────────────────────────────┐ (envs for every tool)
 Genome_Onboarding → indexes, basic.gtf,            │
   chrom.sizes, TSS formakeheatmap lists ───────────┼──────────────┐
                                                    ▼              ▼
 FASTQ ─► RNAseqMapping (RNA/TT-seq) ─► BAM, bedGraph/bigWig, DESeq2
      └─► pipeline2     (PRO/Start)   ─► ref+spike BAM, 3'/5' bedGraphs, matrices, DESeq2
                 │                │                 │            │
 NIH_scripts ◄───┤ make_heatmap, bowtie2stdBedGraph, bedgraphs2stdBedGraph, normalize
   (shared)      │                │                 │            │
                 ▼                ▼                 ▼            ▼
          prepareBrowser    proTSScall        TSScall ─► GeneAnnotationScripts (GGA)
          (browser tracks)  (dominant TSS)   (5'→TSS)   dominant TSS/TES: WORKING_FILE,
                 │                │                       for_dREG, formakeheatmap, gtf
                 ▼                │                               │
           pauseIndex            │        ┌──────────────┬───────┼────────────┐
                 ▲───────────────┘        ▼              ▼       ▼             ▼
                 └──(browser bg)      DOBBE_F      metagene_   Expression-   peakMorph
                                      (dREG eRNA)  heatmap     Matching      _toolkit
                                                   _tool       (+DESeq2)
 smartSlurm = substrate under RNAseqMapping / pipeline2 / DOBBE_F / ChIPseq.
 slurmless (now in-tree at smartSlurm/slurmless/; standalone repo deprecated) tests smartSlurm itself.
```

## Shared format currency (the glue)
- **`formakeheatmap` list** (`ID, desc, chr, start, end, strand [+extras]`) — the common
  TSS/gene-list format. From GGA / proTSScall / Genome_Onboarding → MHT, pauseIndex,
  peakMorph, DOBBE_F (all via `make_heatmap`).
- **Stranded bedGraph** — `_forward`/`_reverse`, `_3pr`/`_5pr`, 0-based, chr-prefixed,
  minus strand stored positive. From mapping → nearly everything.
- **GGA outputs** — `*_WORKING_FILE.txt`, `*_for_dREG.txt`, `*_ActiveTranscripts…gtf` →
  DOBBE_F, MHT, Expression-Matching.
- **DESeq2 output** — `*_results_table.txt`, `matrix/*.makeHeatmap.rds` → Expression-Matching.
- **PRO-seq metadata CSV** — `library_id … ref_genome, spike_genome, outdir …` — shared
  sample sheet across pipeline2, DOBBE_F, prepareBrowser, pauseIndex, peakMorph.

## Conventions & caveats
- **O2 + group paths** everywhere (`hpc_ntc` vs `hpc_adelman`); little runs off-cluster.
- **rAP vs hand-rolled DAG**: RNAseqMapping/pipeline2/DOBBE_F/ChIPseq are smartSlurm; GGA/
  MHT/peakMorph submit plain dependent `sbatch` jobs. (ChIPseq also keeps a legacy fan-out.)
- **runAsPipeline CLI**: authoritative smartSlurm is now branch **`master`** (the `ux-update`
  work merged 2026-10-22 and that branch was deleted), which uses **named flags**
  (`--script --tmp --mode --lint --pipeline`) and the `#@end` explicit block-closure mode.
  The legacy positional form (`"script" noTmp run`) in the pipeline READMEs is stale and not
  accepted — see `reference/runAsPipeline-grammar.md`.
- **TSScall ≠ proTSScall** (different mechanisms; proTSScall is not a fork).
- **make_heatmap** binary (NIH_scripts) is a hard dependency for most analysis tools.
- **smartSlurm ↔ slurmless are co-versioned.** slurmless now lives in-tree at
  `smartSlurm/slurmless/` (merged 2026-11-11; the standalone `slurmless_smartSlurm_testing` is
  **deprecated**). Any smartSlurm engine change must be **paired with a slurmless harness update**
  (a test block that fails without it) and reviewed with the **`smartslurm-adversary`** skill
  before on-cluster testing or an upstream push.
- **EO ↔ repo-agent comms live in each fork's `.claude/` on its DEFAULT branch** (so notes are
  findable without knowing a feature-branch name). EO → agent: `ntc-ecosystem.md` (context),
  `ntc-todo.md` (backlog projection + open-brief index), `ntc-brief-<topic>.md` (ad-hoc job specs;
  the brief names the branch the work targets). Agent → EO: append to repo-owned `ntc-changelog.md`
  (EO harvests via `scripts/ntc-collect-changelogs.sh`). Agents read `ntc-ecosystem.md` + `ntc-todo.md`
  + `ls .claude/ntc-brief-*.md` at session start. Full convention: `docs/update-workflow.md`.
